entries.logic: Encapsulates the creation and display of system alerts (Information, Warning, Error) in a specialized service. Uses JavaFX Alert API.
entries.rationale: Separates the UI notification logic from the view, allowing for easier testing and a consistent look-and-feel for all system messages.

entries.logic: Triggers an information dialog from the Help menu or Welcome pane, displaying app name, version, and description metadata.
entries.rationale: Provides a predictable way for users to verify system status and build information, a key requirement for SSQLM observability.
